Task #1071: Fix homework names, drop dead fixtures

## Goal

Leave `homework/` with no file nothing runs and no name that breaks `AGENTS.md` (Names, Word names, Routing table, Script form, Paths), so a reader meets one convention in all three plugins. Owner, 2026-10-28, https://github.com/kalaluthien/mumu-claude-plugin/issues/1064: "레포 한 번 정리해. 쓰지 않는 playbook이나 관련 스크립트 같은 거 낡은거 전부" and, widened (https://github.com/kalaluthien/mumu-claude-plugin/issues/1064#issuecomment-6459763476), "파일 이름 함수 이름 헤더 이름 개념 이름 일관성이나 규칙 안맞는것도 전수 조사해서 일치시켜".

- Scope: `homework/` only. Behaviour is kept, which passes on the base too and so is no criterion: the judge reruns `probe-dejavu.py` (17 of 17) and `replay-score.py` (same output as the base) at the head.
- Evidence for each removal: `drift.jsonl` and `lessons.jsonl` are named by no script, hook or routing table, only by the hook docstring's phrase "the other fixtures" (the line in `harness-authoring.md` on a hook's `fixtures/*.jsonl` is generic advice for an eval case and stays); both replay scripts read only `labels.json` and `sessions.json`, and `AGENTS.md` keeps a fixture only with the script that replays it. Every other file is named by `hooks.json`, a routing table, a playbook or a script that imports it.
- Concepts that two plugins name differently take the list the teamwork worker files on https://github.com/kalaluthien/mumu-claude-plugin/issues/1062. That list does not exist yet, so this task leaves it out and backlog #1064 stays open for it.
